profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cisco
profile.summary:
Object-Oriented Analysis, Design and Development / Relational Database Systems
•	Software developer with years of experience coding.
•	15+ years of comprehensive and broad knowledge of scripting, systems, networks, test, and automation.
•	Efficient with emphasis on readability, maintainability, reusability
•	Proficiency with tools, systems, networks, languages, etc

Technical Tools
Languages: python, C++, php, MySQL, HTML, CSS, Javascript
Platforms: Windows Server, Linux, Mac
Networking: Cisco, Sonicwall, Netgear, Dell, VoIP
Hardware/Systems: Dell, Hp, Exchange
Certs: CompTIA, CCNA

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Company Acquired by Cisco
Development of complete regression test suites (in python) for product design validation (DVT) and system validation test (SVT) for silicon photonics based products; primarily, 40G/100G/200G/400G/800G/1.6T optoelectronic transceivers. Responsibilities include test plan development, framework and test development, test execution, library maintenance, bug / defect tracking, and lab / systems infrastructure build and support. Other duties include customer issue debug/troubleshooting.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Designed and maintained a robust and automated email marketing platform for high-end advertising campaigns. Developed the front and backend interface in Python, C++, MySQL, PHP, HTML, CSS. Used best practices with Ad network API’s and CAN-SPAM act. Proactively used algorithms to maximize hit rates. Online Marketing, Email, Data, Hygiene, Leads, Publishers, Advertisers.
